additional_nonblocking_note: Resolved: metadata/report selection rejects known whole-object paths and source/archive payload suffixes. The only compressed scientific exception is a gate-bound case-insensitive .jsonl.gz name; its original expected SHA remains enforced.

limitation: This review does not authorize or attest any actual collection, audit, delivery pack, upload, or restoration.

resolved_findings.finding: External artifact inventory recomputes expected_sha256 from mutable current bytes instead of preserving the digest accepted by load_ready. An external final report changed after its gate check is silently rebound and could be archived despite a conflicting final_snapshot binding.
resolved_findings.requested_fix: Carry exact accepted digests for every gated or audited artifact through inventory and ZIP verification; never replace a bound expected digest by a later hash.

resolved_findings.finding: The supplied reuse_expectations file is not checked against original_plan.reuse_expectations_binding. Archive/member fields can change while matching whole-source SHA, size, and ETag, yielding an accepted but unrestorable dependency map.
resolved_findings.requested_fix: Verify the exact original frozen reuse_expectations digest both when building dependencies and when accepting them.

resolved_findings.finding: A required internal artifact deleted after the gate was previously omitted from the census and archive.
resolved_findings.resolution: Inventory now requires every gate-bound artifact path to occur among archive entries.

integration_limitations: The expensive source-ready validator was mocked only in pack-level synthetic tests; its production call and digest propagation were inspected statically.
No full 113-source actual integration or final scientific delivery attestation was exercised.
No restorer execution in this review; separately owned independent tests cover restoration.

narrow_followup.change: Allow gate-bound .jsonl.gz replay artifacts and retain original_external_path for external member relocation.
narrow_followup.additional_affected_test: External original-path propagation additionally verified inside the ZIP member manifest after extending that test.
